text:
maria_cs: quick update from ElmStreet dry-run — we're seeing egress CIDR overlap with their datacenter range (10.2.0.0/16). Can infra weigh in? @sanjay_se @elliot_infra

sanjay_se: ack. they gave us 10.2.0.0/16 for on‑prem? what's our proposed VPC CIDR right now?

elliot_infra: we actually provisioned 10.2.0.0/18 earlier for the smoke env which explains the collision. not great. propose either move to 10.10.0.0/16 or scope our VPC to 10.3.0.0/16 and NAT for egress. leaning toward avoiding touching customer on‑prem ranges.

maria_cs: important for the cutover timeline — if we need net changes that'll add a day. customer expects week0 smoke tests tomorrow. :grimacing:

elliot_infra: quick snapshot of current vs proposed:
```
current_vpc: 10.2.0.0/18  # smoke
prod_vpc: 10.2.128.0/17
proposed_vpc: 10.10.0.0/16
```

audrey_security: also a KMS note — ElmStreet requires a key policy that includes their security account principals and rotation every 90 days. need to confirm IAM ARNs. sample policy snippet (redacted):

```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ElmOps"]},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

DeployBot: DeployBot: dry-run job elmstreet-dry-887 queued by maria_cs — logs: https://ci.reddemo/elmstreet/887 (job started)

maria_cs: okay action items:
• network: pick final CIDR and confirm routing plan (owner: sanjay_se)
• infra: migrate smoke env if needed (owner: elliot_infra)
• security: finalize KMS policy + ask customer for IAM list (owner: audrey_security)
• obs: set audit log sampling policy for week0 (owner: ryan_prod)
If any of these are blocked >3 business days we mark as renewal risk and escalate to AM.

ryan_prod: for observability I'd set audit log sampling to 100% for week0 (first 72h) then drop to 5% for steady state. retention: 90d in hot tier, then 365d cold tier. will send config patch. :clipboard:

audrey_security: ack. also question — do they require KMS HSM backing (BYOK/HSM)? I asked the customer in yesterday's call but no answer yet. if yes, provisioning lead time is ~5 business days.

sanjay_se: I can propose moving smoke -> 10.3.0.0/16 overnight so prod doesn't move; gives us isolation. ETA 24h. will post exact subnet map once done.

maria_cs: perfect. tagging owners: @sanjay_se (CIDR decision + subnet map), @elliot_infra (smoke migration), @audrey_security (KMS policy + HSM check), @ryan_prod (audit sampling + retention). If any blocker appears, I'll update AM and log renewal risk. :warning:

elliot_infra: pushed a quick runbook fragment to the thread for peer routing we can reuse:
```
# example route for VPC peering -> onprem
route 10.2.0.0/16 via peering-conn-elm
# ensure no overlapping subnets, add nat gateway for egress translation if required
```

maria_cs: thanks everyone — I'll capture the runbook in Confluence and ping ElmStreet for the IAM list + HSM answer. reconvene midday for cutover greenlight. :raised_hands:
